submission.justification: Mixture-G2 with a 2.0 mm gas gap provides a time resolution of 1.329 ns, which comfortably meets the hard requirement of ≤1.5 ns while maintaining a safety margin. This mixture offers the best balance between performance and environmental compliance. While Mixture-G1 achieves better time resolution (0.869 ns at 2.5 mm), G2 is described as having "a partial substitute for the fluorinated component," suggesting it was specifically developed to reduce environmental impact compared to the standard G1 mixture, making it more likely to meet the GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement. Mixture-G3 fails to meet the time resolution requirement at any gap size (all measurements >2.0 ns). The 2.0 mm gap for G2 provides the optimal time resolution for this mixture, showing the best performance in the 1-3 mm range tested.
